status: Partial Icarus Dash template: conditional recharge, collision-resolved horizontal displacement and receipt-observed airborne kill Cure; full original movement, classification and production assembly remain incomplete

known.enhanced_qualification: Heat Rises active OR Song of Flame active while Incinerator Snap is equipped; Celestial Fire alone does not qualify

policies: One persistent uses/progress pair; first use from full resets the meter, later uses retain progress. This reset/start policy requires original-game calibration.

Expansion does not grant free charges; shrink clips uses, retaining progress. Buff or loadout changes apply current 4s/5s rate to later segments. These transition policies require original-game calibration.

Minecraft projection is an immediate collision-resolved horizontal displacement from server yaw. It does not reproduce the original dash animation, velocity curve or movement-input-relative direction.
Heat Rises, Song of Flame, Daybreak and Incinerator Snap are consumed as explicit state/source tags. Test producers use synthetic buffs and a selected melee marker, not complete abilities.

Airborne means the credited actor has an observed native movement snapshot with on_ground=false at confirmed damage completion. Launch-time/current flags are not substituted; swimming, riding and other posture interactions remain uncalibrated.

Guardian takes the explicit player flag. Combatants require exactly one known rank among rank_and_file, elite, boss, miniboss and champion across entity/type tags; only the first three have supported weights. Unknown or conflicting evidence emits a diagnostic and neither counts nor refreshes.

Only qualifying kills reset the five-second progress lifetime; landing or an ineligible kill does not clear it. Exact expiry is processed before a new kill. Threshold consumes all progress and excess, even if shared Cure cooldown rejects recovery. These boundary policies need original-game calibration.

Counter is recipient-shared. A separate non-refreshing five-second receipt bucket uses death_id to prevent duplicate delivery across concurrent sources, including the threshold kill. Buckets expire independently of progress; this is dispatch deduplication, not a permanent event replay ledger.

Removing the last tagged Cure source or holder death clears progress/receipt state; same-provider replacement preserves it. Already accepted shared Cure follows its own lifetime. These lifecycle policies remain explicit content choices.

Icarus invokes the existing shared Cure bundle, preserving ability attribution and the recipient cooldown. Absolute HP uses the pre-existing 0.1 Minecraft test scale with equal pulses at 50/100ms; neither is a calibrated full-game curve.
unresolved: Miniboss/Champion counter weights, original airborne sampling/posture and landing/reset/overflow/source-removal policies are not independently calibrated; full Super and weapon/status kill-credit classification remain incomplete.
Original inter-dash lockout, cycle-start timing, mode transition energy grants and Daybreak-specific cooldown/Super cost need calibration.
Full Heat Rises / Song of Flame / Daybreak, subclass/aspect assembly, air-move key, animation, HUD, persistence and cross-loader graphical acceptance remain incomplete.
